reviews.review:
This game is a game i'd recommend
I'm not doing this for the steam nominee awards. I'm serious this game you will not regret.
Once you figure out the best way to run around the map to maximize gold and items the game really becomes a lot of fun. Stringing items together to destroy monsters never gets old.

truly a gem, in terms of side scroller shooters, this was a masterpiece. the only flaw, and its a big one, is that the way the online multiplayer works.... sucks. what do i mean? well, ever have to open a port on your router and let a game through a firewall before? well, if you havent, youre gonna spend a few hours figuring it all out. still, this game doesnt have to be enjoyed in multiplayer, its good enough if that wasnt even a thing. just a little less good.
